report.explanation: All observed checkout requests returned HTTP 200 with durations of 78-344 ms; traces show successful inventory, payment, and order spans with healthy Redis and Postgres pool metrics (size 1, idle 1). No error, timeout, or saturation is present in the admitted evidence. The alert does not establish any taxonomy cause, so no bounded candidate can be substantiated. Metrics and topology were excluded, leaving insufficient evidence to diagnose.
missing_evidence: Gateway and downstream service metrics (latency percentiles, error rates, saturation) to test for latency or resource faults
Topology data to confirm call paths and identify any degraded dependency
Baseline latency expectations to determine whether 344 ms is anomalous
Error/timeout logs or failed spans from inventory, payment, or order services
